ActionOnlyMessage.title: ActionOnlyMessage
ActionOnlyMessage.description: A template for messages that silently execute an allowlisted special message action with no UI. Records an impression before attempting action.

type.description: The type of the special message action to execute.

action.description: The special message action to execute. Only allowlisted action types may be used.

BookmarksBarButton.title: BookmarksBarButton
BookmarksBarButton.description: A template with a label and a special message action (currently only supports OPEN_URL)

InfoBar.title: InfoBar
InfoBar.description: A template with an image, test and buttons.

type.description: Specifies where the message should appear and persist: 'global' (persists across tabs in the current window), 'tab' (only visible in the current tab), or 'universal' (visible across all tabs and windows, current and future).

text.description: Either a single localizableText, or an array of raw strings and/or localizableText objects. localizableText can contain an optional href property for the text to be rendered as a link.

allOf.description: Additional arguments, only a `where` override is currently allowed

dismissable.description: Should the infobar include an X dismiss button, defaults to true

dismissOnPrefChange.description: If set, one or more prefs to observe. The infobar will automatically dismiss when any of these prefs is set for the first time or when its value changes.

dismiss_action.description: Optional Special Message Action dispatched via dispatchUserAction when the user dismisses the infobar (X button). Any action type is allowed, including MULTI_ACTION, which SpecialMessageActions unpacks natively.

canReplace.description: IDs of other infobar messages this infobar may replace

id.description: A stable identifier for this button, reported as `event_context.source` on click telemetry. Defaults to `button_<index>` when omitted.

label.description: The text label of the button.

dismiss.description: Should the infobar be dismissed when the action is dispatched, defaults to true

supportPage.description: A page title on SUMO to link to

linkUrls.description: Map of Fluent data-l10n-name keys to real URLs

linkActions.description: Map of Fluent data-l10n-name keys to a Special Message Action dispatched when the link is clicked (in addition to opening the URL).

dismiss.description: If true, dismiss the infobar after handling this link's action. Defaults to false.

inline_icons.description: Inline icons to slot into the message text. Each key must match the `data-l10n-name` of an `` placeholder in the Fluent string; a placeholder with no entry here is dropped. Set `alt` on that `` in the Fluent string.

rtlImageURL.description: Optional alternative URL used in RTL locales.

style.description: Optional CSS overrides for this infobar. Currently, only `background-color` and `font-size` may be set. `background-color` will only apply when the user does not prefer high-contrast.

background-color.description: Any valid CSS color or light-dark() expression.

font-size.description: Any valid CSS font-size value - rem units recommended to ensure size is relative to the system font size.

localizableTextWithHref.description: Everything a localizableText allows, plus a required href

rawTextWithHref.description: A literal text chunk that must include href

once.description: If true, only fire on first impression.

MenuMessage.title: MenuMessage
MenuMessage.description: A template for messages that appear within our menus.

messageType.description: The subtype of the message. 'fxa_cta' is used for Firefox Accounts messaging and is only visible when signed out, unless 'allowWhenSignedIn' property is provided. It replaces the fxa menu item when displayed. 'default_cta' is used for general messages, regardless of sign in state and only visible within the App Menu.

primaryText.description: The primary text for the message, which offers the value proposition to the user.

secondaryText.description: The secondary text for the message, which offers more detail on the value proposition to the user. Not displayed when layout is 'simple'.

closeAction.description: The action to take upon clicking the close button.

primaryAction.description: The action to take upon clicking the primary action button.

primaryActionText.description: The label for the primary action.

primaryButtonSize.description: The size of the primary button, default is 'default'.

imageURL.description: URL for image to use with the content.

rtlImageURL.description: URL for RTL images that have directionally dependent assets and cannot be flipped using 'directionalImage'.

imageWidth.description: The image width in pixels. Default is 120px.

directionalImage.description: If true, the illustration has a left/right orientation and should be horizontally mirrored in RTL contexts. Defaults to false.

logoURL.description: URL for logo to use with the content.

logoWidth.description: The logo width in pixels. Default is 18px.

imageVerticalTopOffset.description: The margin-block-start value to apply to the image in pixels.

imageVerticalBottomOffset.description: The margin-block-end value to apply to the image in pixels, used in 'row' layouts.

containerVerticalBottomOffset.description: The container's margin-block-end value in pixels. Used to visually offset the image in 'row' layouts when 'imageVerticalBottomOffset' is applied.

containerPaddingBottom.description: The container's padding-block-end value in pixels.

layout.description: The layout of the message content and illustration. Row displays the image inline to the right of the text, column displays the image above the text. Simple layout only displays primary text and primary button on one row. Split displays the illustration in one column and a stacked content column, use 'imagePosition' to swap which side the illustration sits on.

imagePosition.description: Position of the illustration. For split layout, 'start' or 'end' selects which inline side the illustration sits on (defaults to 'end'). For both split and column layout, 'bottom' renders the illustration at the bottom of the card.

allowWhenSignedIn.description: If true, the message will be shown even when the user is signed in. For 'fxa_cta' messages. Defaults to 'false'.

NewtabPromoMessage.title: PBNewtabPromoMessage
NewtabPromoMessage.description: Message shown on the private browsing newtab page.

hideDefault.description: Should we hide the default promo after the experiment promo is dismissed.

promoEnabled.description: Should we show the promo section.

promoType.description: Promo type used to determine if promo should show to a given user

promoSectionStyle.description: Sets the position of the promo section. Possible values are: top, below-search, bottom. Default bottom.

promoTitle.description: The text content of the promo section.

promoTitleEnabled.description: Should we show text content in the promo section.

promoLinkText.description: The text of the link in the promo box.

promoHeader.description: The title of the promo section.

promoLinkType.description: Type of promo link type. Possible values: link, button. Default is link.

promoImageLarge.description: URL for image used on the left side of the promo box, larger, showcases some feature. Default off.

promoImageSmall.description: URL for image used on the right side of the promo box, smaller, usually a logo. Default off.

NewtabMessage.title: NewtabMessage
NewtabMessage.description: A template for messages that are rendered within newtab

SidebarChatBotPromo.title: SidebarChatBotPromo
SidebarChatBotPromo.description: A template for promo messages that appear in the genai chat sidebar.

type.description: The visual style of the promo (passed through to moz-promo).

heading.description: The heading text of the promo.

message.description: The body text of the promo.

label.description: The label for the primary action button.

action.description: The action to take upon clicking the primary button.

label.description: The label for the dismiss action button. Uses `additional_button` rather than `secondary_button` because the onboarding provider pre-translates `secondary_button` labels via Fluent, which breaks labels that are not `{ string_id }`.

action.description: The action to take upon clicking the dismiss button.

SmartWindowNewtabPromo.title: SmartWindowNewtabPromo
SmartWindowNewtabPromo.description: A template for promo messages that appear on the Smart Window new tab page.

type.description: The visual style of the promo (passed through to moz-promo).

heading.description: The heading text of the promo.

message.description: The body text of the promo.

imageSrc.description: URL of the image to display.

imageAlignment.description: Alignment of the image within the promo.

dismissable.description: When true, shows moz-promo's built-in top-right close (X) button. Dismissing hides the promo and records telemetry. Defaults to false.

label.description: The label for the primary action button.

action.description: The action to take upon clicking the primary button.

label.description: The label for the additional action button.

action.description: The action to take upon clicking the additional button.

Spotlight.title: Spotlight
Spotlight.description: A template with an image, title, content and two buttons.

template.description: Specify the layout template for the Spotlight

imageURL.description: URL for image to use with the content

imageId.description: The ID for a remotely hosted image

transitions.description: Show transitions within and between screens

disableEscClose.description: Don't allow the message to be dismissed using the ESC key - for limited use in Spotlight modals only when the message content clearly informs the user that a decision is required to proceed

write_in_microsurvey.description: Set to true to apply the write-in microsurvey data policy. This is required for write-in microsurveys. Messages using the textarea tile should always set this to true. It prevents client_id from being recorded with any telemetry events for the message, recording a unique impression_id instead. It also sends the events on the more restrictive microsurvey ping instead of the messaging-system ping.

disableHistoryUpdates.description: Don't alter the browser session's history stack - used with messaging surfaces like Feature Callouts

startScreen.description: Index of first screen to show from message, defaulting to 0

no-rdm.description: If true, prevents the spotlight from entering responsive design mode at widths less than 800px

template.description: Specify whether the surface is shown as a Spotlight modal or an in-surface Feature Callout dialog

ToastNotification.title: ToastNotification
ToastNotification.description: A template for toast notifications displayed by the Alert service.

title.description: Id of localized string or message override of toast notification title

body.description: Id of localized string or message override of toast notification body

icon_url.description: The URL of the image used as an icon of the toast notification.

image_url.description: The URL of an image to be displayed as part of the notification.

dark_mode_image_url.description: The URL of an image to be displayed as part of the notification in dark mode.

reduced_motion_image_url.description: The URL of an image to be displayed as part of the notification when the user prefers reduced motion.

dark_mode_reduced_motion_image_url.description: The URL of an image to be displayed as part of the notification in dark mode with reduced motion.

launch_url.description: The URL to launch when the notification or an action button is clicked.

type.description: The launch action to be performed when Firefox is launched.

requireInteraction.description: Whether the toast notification should remain active until the user clicks or dismisses it, rather than closing automatically.

tag.description: An identifying tag for the toast notification.

data.description: Arbitrary data associated with the toast notification.

title.description: The action text to be shown to the user.

action.description: Opaque identifer that identifies action.

iconURL.description: URL of an icon to display with the action.

windowsSystemActivationType.description: Whether to have Windows process the given `action`.

type.description: The launch action to be performed when Firefox is launched.

ToolbarBadgeMessage.title: ToolbarBadgeMessage
ToolbarBadgeMessage.description: A template that specifies to which element in the browser toolbar to add a notification.

action.description: Optional action to take in addition to showing the notification

delay.description: Optional delay in ms after which to show the notification

badgeDescription.description: This is used in combination with the badged button to offer a text based alternative to the visual badging. Example 'New Feature: What's New'

UpdateAction.title: UpdateActionMessage
UpdateAction.description: A template for messages that execute predetermined actions.

data.description: Additional data provided as argument when executing the action

url.description: URL data to be used as argument to the action

expireDelta.description: Expiration timestamp to be used as argument to the action

action.description: Optional action to take in addition to showing the notification

UrlbarAction.title: UrlbarAction
UrlbarAction.description: A template for messages that add a quick action button to the address bar, shown when the user types one of its keywords. Frequency caps are not currently supported, and no impressions, exposure or messaging telemetry are recorded; use the urlbar engagement telemetry, where actions appear as `fxms_<key>`.

key.description: Unique identifier for the action. Firefox registers it as `fxms_<key>`, which is how it appears in urlbar telemetry.

keywords.description: Typed text that shows the action. A localized string may hold several comma separated keywords.

label.description: Text displayed on the action button.

icon.description: A chrome:// or resource:// URL of an icon that ships with Firefox.

type.description: The special message action run when the action is picked.

groups.description: Array of preferences used to control `enabled` status of the group. If any is `false` the group is disabled.

template.description: Which messaging template this message is using.

frequency.description: An object containing frequency cap information for a message.

lifetime.description: The maximum lifetime impressions for a message.

custom.description: An array of custom frequency cap definitions.

items.description: A frequency cap definition containing time and max impression information

period.description: Period of time in milliseconds (e.g. 86400000 for one day)

cap.description: The maximum impressions for the message within the defined period.

priority.description: The priority of the message. If there are two competing messages to show, the one with the highest priority will be shown

order.description: The order in which messages should be shown. Messages will be shown in increasing order.

targeting.description: A JEXL expression representing targeting information

triggers.description: An array of trigger actions (alternative to the singular `trigger`). The message is eligible if any one of them matches. When 'trigger' is also present, `triggers` takes precedence. Targeting is evaluated using the context of whichever trigger fired, so context a trigger contributes (for example `tabsClosedCount` from `nthTabClosed`) is only available when that specific trigger fires. Ensure the targeting expression is valid for every trigger listed.

provider.description: An identifier for the provider of this message, such as "cfr" or "preview".

string_id.description: Id of localized string to be rendered.

localizableText.description: Either a raw string or an object containing the string_id of the localized text

Trigger.description: An action to trigger potentially showing the message

id.description: A string identifying the trigger action

params.description: An optional array of string parameters for the trigger action

MultiStageProtonScreen.title: MultiStageProtonScreen
MultiStageProtonScreen.description: A non-enforcing schema for the content of a multistage screen. Keep updated with any new/removed properties to MultiStageProtonScreen.jsx.

id.description: The unique identifier of the screen content. Each screen in a message should have a different ID, which can be referenced in actions to update the tour pref and advance screens.

force_hide_steps_indicator.description: If true, hides a series of dots that would show up at the bottom of the screen, indicating which screen the user is on. Defaults to false and will already be hidden if there's only one screen.

auto_dismiss.description: If present, the message is dismissed automatically once this screen has been shown for the given time. The countdown only runs while the page is visible, and starts over when the page becomes visible again. A card-stack message with transitions enabled plays its exit animation before it is dismissed. Screens are not dismissed automatically by default.

after.description: The time in milliseconds the screen is shown for before the message is dismissed.

anchors.description: An array of anchor objects. Each anchor object represents a single element on the page that the callout should be anchored to. The callout will be anchored to the first visible element in the array.

position.description: The layout position of the screen.

fullscreen.description: If true, the screens are displayed in fullscreen.

progress_bar.description: If true, the progress bar will be shown. Defaults to true.

background.description: The CSS background for the screen.

background_static.description: The static CSS background for the screen, provided if the default background has animated content.

hero_image.description: The hero image in the content.

url.description: The default URL of the hero image.

static_url.description: The URL of the static hero image, provided if the default hero image has animated content.

card_stack_image.description: The image to insert into the secondary section background if the screen is a card stack.

type.description: The style of the image, which determines how it will fill the container and behave at breakpoints. Defaults to float.

background_uncropped.description: The static CSS background to use with the 'bleed' image type

background_medium.description: The static CSS background to use at the middle breakpoint with the banner image type

background_small.description: The static CSS background to use at the smallest breakpoint with the banner image type

label.description: The text to show next to the checkbox.

defaultValue.description: The default value of the checkbox.

action.description: The special message action invoked if the checkbox is selected.

label.description: The text to show inside the primary button.

action.description: The special message action invoked if the primary button is clicked.

targeting.description: The JEXL targeting for conditional button display.

has_arrow_icon.description: If true, shows an arrow icon next to the label.

disabled.description: If true, disables the button. If 'hasActiveMultiSelect', disables the button until the user selects something in the multiselect tiles. If 'hasTextInput', disables the button while the textarea tile is empty or exceeds the character limit. If 'hasActiveSingleSelect', disables the button until the user selects an option in the single-select tile.

style.description: Overrides the style of the button.

label.description: The text to show inside the secondary button.

action.description: The special message action invoked if the secondary button is clicked.

targeting.description: The JEXL targeting for conditional button display.

has_arrow_icon.description: If true, shows an arrow icon next to the label.

disabled.description: If true, disables the button. If 'hasActiveMultiSelect', disables the button until the user selects something in the multiselect tiles. If 'hasTextInput', disables the button while the textarea tile is empty or exceeds the character limit. If 'hasActiveSingleSelect', disables the button until the user selects an option in the single-select tile.

style.description: Overrides the style of the button.

text.description: Extra text to show before the button.

secondary_button_top.description: The secondary button(s) at the top of the screen.

label.description: The text to show inside the secondary button.

action.description: The special message action invoked if the secondary button is clicked.

targeting.description: The JEXL targeting for conditional button display.

oneOf.description: Use an array when there are multiple secondary buttons at the top of the screen.

label.description: The text to show inside the secondary button.

action.description: The special message action invoked if the secondary button is clicked.

targeting.description: The JEXL targeting for conditional button display.

label.description: The text to show inside the additional button.

action.description: The special message action invoked if the additional button is clicked.

targeting.description: The JEXL targeting for conditional button display.

disabled.description: If true, disables the button. If 'hasActiveMultiSelect', disables the button until the user selects something in the multiselect tiles. If 'hasTextInput', disables the button while the textarea tile is empty or exceeds the character limit. If 'hasActiveSingleSelect', disables the button until the user selects an option in the single-select tile.

style.description: Overrides the style of the button.

flow.description: If there are several buttons, this property can control the orietnation of the buttons.

alignment.description: Justification and alignment of the buttons row/column. Defaults to 'end'.

label.description: Optionally used to control the aria attributes and tooltip.

action.description: The special message action invoked if the primary button is clicked.

size.description: The size of the button (20px, 24px, 32px). Defaults to 32px.

marginBlock.description: A CSS override for the marginBlock property.

marginInline.description: A CSS override for the marginInline property.

background.description: If true, adds a background to the dismiss button.

submenu_button.description: A submenu button that can be attached to another button.

label.description: Optionally used to control the aria label and can be used to override CSS styles.

style.description: Overrides the style of the button. Should be set to the same style as the button it's attached to.

attached_to.description: The button that the submenu split button is attached to.

submenu.description: The dropdown menu that appear when the user clicks the split button.

split_narrow_bkg_position.description: The background position for narrow split layouts.

autohide.description: If true, the callout hides on outside clicks.

width.description: The callout card width as a CSS value. Defaults to 400px.

padding.description: The callout card padding as a CSS value. Defaults to 16px.

layout.description: A layout variant for the screen. 'inline' is a single row layout that works well in tandem with title_logo. 'last-card' is the final card-stack screen, with the title and subtitle split around a centered image slot.

zap_border.description: If true, adds a colorful gradient border to the screen. This is only supported for screens with 'hide_arrow'. There is no effect if HCM or a custom theme add-on is enabled.

zap_shadow.description: If true, adds a colorful gradient shadow to the screen. This is only supported for screens with 'hide_arrow' and either 'absolute_position' or 'arrow_position'. There is no effect if HCM or a custom theme add-on is enabled.

zap_border_gradient.description: If present, a custom gradient to use in conjunction with the 'background' and 'zap_border' properties. Only applied if both other properties are present.

logo.description: An optional object representing a large illustration to show above other content.

darkModeReducedMotionImageURL.description: The dark mode reduced motion image URL.

videoURL.description: A video URL, played once, rendered instead of the image ones above. Ignored (falls back to the image URLs above) for users who prefer reduced motion.

rtl.description: Right-to-left replacements for any of the URLs above, applied over them when the document is RTL. Omitted keys keep their base value.

width.description: The CSS style overriding the width property.

height.description: The CSS style overriding the height property.

marginBlock.description: The CSS style overriding the marginBlock property.

marginInline.description: The CSS style overriding the marginInline property.

center_image.description: An optional image shown in the center image slot of the 'last-card' layout, revealed once the text split animation completes.

darkModeReducedMotionImageURL.description: The dark mode reduced motion image URL.

rtl.description: Right-to-left replacements for any of the URLs above, applied over them when the document is RTL. Omitted keys keep their base value.

width.description: The CSS width of the image slot. The split animation and margins adapt to it. Defaults to 120px.

height.description: The CSS height of the image slot. Defaults to 120px.

marginBlock.description: The CSS style overriding the marginBlock property. Useful for aligning the image's focal point with the text. Does not apply on narrow breakpoints.

marginInline.description: The CSS style overriding the marginInline property. Does not apply on narrow breakpoints.

corner_image.description: An optional object representing an illustration anchored to a corner of the screen. The fullscreen center-large layout anchors it to the window; every other layout anchors it to the card.

darkModeReducedMotionImageURL.description: The dark mode reduced motion image URL.

rtl.description: Right-to-left replacements for any of the URLs above, applied over them when the document is RTL. Omitted keys keep their base value.

position.description: The corner the illustration is anchored to. Defaults to 'bottom-right'. The -start/-end values are direction-relative and resolve against the text direction, so they mirror in RTL; the left/right values are always that physical corner.

width.description: The CSS style overriding the width property.

height.description: The CSS style overriding the height property.

marginBlock.description: The CSS style overriding the marginBlock property.

marginInline.description: The CSS style overriding the marginInline property.

style.description: CSS overrides applied to the illustration container. Avoid 'translate' and 'scale' when using 'entrance_animation', which animates those two properties and would be overridden by them. 'transform' is unaffected.

entrance_animation.description: How the illustration animates in each time the screen is entered. The direction is derived from 'position', so a 'bottom-left' illustration rises and a 'top-left' one descends. Every type degrades to an opacity-only fade for users who prefer reduced motion.

type.description: The animation to run. Defaults to 'none'.

distance.description: The CSS length the illustration travels, for the 'slide-*' types.

duration.description: The CSS time the animation takes.

delay.description: The CSS time to wait before starting, for staggering the illustration against the screen's other content.

title_logo.description: An optional object representing an icon to show next to the title.

darkModeReducedMotionImageURL.description: The dark mode reduced motion image URL.

width.description: The CSS style overriding the width property.

height.description: The CSS style overriding the height property.

marginBlock.description: The CSS style overriding the marginBlock property.

marginInline.description: The CSS style overriding the marginInline property.

alignment.description: The logo alignment relative to the title.

subtitle.description: The text to show below the title.

above_button_content.description: An extra block of configurable content below the title/subtitle but above the main buttons. Can be placed above the 'tiles' by setting 'tiles_container.position' to 'after_supporting_content'.

oneOf.description: A localizableThing that can be combined with 'link_key's to attach actions to the `<a data-l10n-name='...'>` markers in the Fluent string.
An array of either raw strings or a localizableThing with 'href'/'link_key'/neither.

href.description: An embedded URL link. Dispatches OPEN_URL with 'args: href'.

where.description: The 'where' argument for the OPEN_URL action.

link_keys.description: A list of the link keys that exist in screen.content. The value of that key must be an object with an 'action' property and the 'string_id' in the 'text' object must refer to a Fluent string that contains an anchor element with `data-l10n-name='LINK_KEY_NAME'`.

steps_indicator.description: Optionally used to override the aria attributes or tooltip of the steps indicator. Not recommended.

tiles.description: The tiles configuration for selection screens.

position.description: The position of the tiles container relative to supporting content like 'above_button_content'. By default, it comes before the supporting content.

tiles_header.description: The header for a tiles container.

reverse_split.description: If true, applies the reverse split layout onto the screen (i.e. inverts the visual order of the split screens).

main_content_style.description: CSS overrides for the main content style on wide screens.

main_content_style_narrow.description: CSS overrides for the main content style on narrow screens.

split_content_justify_content.description: A CSS override allowing custom justify content on split screens.

action_buttons_above_content.description: If true, displays action buttons above main content.

has_noodles.description: If true, adds noodle illustrations that peek out behind the screen.

narrow.description: If true, sets narrow attribute to the outer element of the screen.

languageSwitcher.description: The language switcher component that appears of there is a language mismatch screen.

text_color.description: Overrides all text color of the screen.

isSystemPromptStyleSpotlight.description: If true, overrides the spotlight screen styling to look like the system prompt style.

screen_style.description: CSS overrides for the screen style.

no_rdm.description: If true, prevents the spotlight from entering responsive design mode at widths less than 800px.

split_content_padding_block.description: The CSS override for the paddingBlock styling for split layout contents.

split_content_padding_inline.description: The CSS override for the paddingInline styling for split layout contents.

cta_paragraph.description: Text below the subtitle that can include hyperlinks.

string_id.description: The Fluent string id for the paragraph text.

string_name.description: The name of the '' marker inside the string_id.

action.description: The special message action to be invoked when the cta text is clicked.

info_text.description: Info text displayed at the bottom of the screen.

isEncryptedBackup.description: If true, displays the encrypted backup method as part of the 'fx_backup_file_path' or 'fx_backup_password' tile type.

migrate_start.description: The action for the migration start event as part of the embedded migration wizard component within about:welcome.

migrate_close.description: The action for the migration close event as part of the embedded migration wizard component within about:welcome.

action_checklist_subtitle.description: The subtitle text for the action checklist.

remove_checklist_button.description: The remove checklist button in the action checklist.

label.description: The text inside the remove checklist button.

source_id.description: The id used to identify the button in telemetry.

action.description: The special message action to invoke when the button is clicked.

more_button.description: A submenu button with a button type of 'more'.

page_event_listeners.description: An optional array of event listeners to add to the page where the screen is shown.

type.description: The event type string. Supports any DOM event type, timeout and interval for timers, internal feature callout events 'touradvance' and 'tourend'.

capture.description: If true, handles events in capturing phase.

once.description: If true, removes listener after first event.

preventDefault.description: If true, prevents default action in event handler.

interval.description: Used only for timeout and interval event types to invoke the action on a timer.

every_window.description: If true, extends addEventListener to all windows.

action.description: The special message action to be invoked.

localizableThing.description: Text that can be a raw string or have a Fluent string_id.

raw.description: A raw, untranslated string, typically used for EN-only experiments.

string_id.description: Fluent string identifier from a .ftl file.

args.description: Arguments for Fluent strings that have variables.

aria_label.description: A string to use as the element's aria-label attribute value.

color.description: A CSS override for the color property.

fontSize.description: A CSS override for the fontSize property.

fontWeight.description: A CSS override for the fontWeight property.

letterSpacing.description: A CSS override for the letterSpacing property.

lineHeight.description: A CSS override for the lineHeight property.

marginBlock.description: A CSS override for the marginBlock property.

marginInline.description: A CSS override for the marginInline property.

paddingBlock.description: A CSS override for the paddingBlock property.

paddingInline.description: A CSS override for the paddingInline property.

whiteSpace.description: A CSS override for the whiteSpace property.

selector.description: A CSS selector for the element to anchor to.

panel_position.description: Represents how the callout should be positioned relative to the anchor element.

anchor_attachment.description: The point on the anchor that the callout should be tied to.

callout_attachment.description: The point on the callout that should be tied to the anchor.

flip.description: The flip behavior to apply to the panel when it would overflow the screen. 'slide' makes the panel slide in the direction it's overflowing, to keep it on screen. If it overflows in the same direction it's aligned relative to the anchor, it will flip in that direction. 'none' just allows the panel to bleed out of bounds, without flipping or sliding.

offset_x.description: Offsets in pixels to apply to the callout position in the horizontal direction.

offset_y.description: Offsets in pixels to apply to the callout position in the vertical direction.

hide_arrow.description: If true, hides the arrow that points from the callout to the anchor.

no_open_on_anchor.description: If true, skips applying the [open] style to the anchor element when the callout is shown.

arrow_width.description: The width of the arrow in a number of pixels. Defulats to 33.94113 (which corresponds to a triangle with 24px edges)

arrow_corner_distance.description: The distance between the arrow and the corner of the parent box element in pixels. Defaults to 12px.

autofocus.description: Allows you to force an element inside the callout to be focused when the callout is shown.

selector.description: A preferred CSS selector, if you want a specific element to be focused.

use_defaults.description: If 'selector' is provided and the element can't be found, and this is set to false, nothing will be selected. If 'selector' is not provided, this must be true. Defaults to true.

action.description: The special message action to perform.

data.description: The data to pass to the action if needed.

dismiss.description: If true, dismisses the callout/tour. Can be used in addition to or instead of a special message action type. If set to 'actionResult', the callout will only be dismissed after the special message action has resolved successfully, will only take effect for certain special message ids, and requires setting 'needsAwait' to true.

needsAwait.description: If true, the action needs to be awaited. Must be true if 'dismiss' is set to 'actionResult'.

navigate.description: If true, navigates to the next step.

collectSelect.description: If true, the actions for selected checkbox/radio selections are performed in series. Set to true if this action is for the primary button and the 'multiselect' tile is used.

advance_screens.description: Indicates that the action should navigate to a different screen.

direction.description: How many screens and in which direction to advance. Positive integers advance forward while negative integers advance backward.

id.description: The id of the screen to advance to. Id takes priority if both id and direction are provided.

submenuItem.description: An item in the dropdown menu inside the submenu_button.

type.description: Submenu can have 3 types of items.

id.description: The id used to identify the submenu item in telemetry.

label.description: The text to show inside the submenu item.

action.description: Used only for type 'action'. The special message action invoked if the submenu item is clicked.

icon.description: An optional URL specifying an icon to show next to the label.

submenu.description: Used only for type 'menu'. The submenu items to show when the user hovers over this item.

tile.description: A tile object. More details can be found in ContentTiles.jsx.

style.description: CSS overrides of the tile container. Any CSS properties starting with '--' are also allowed.

layout.description: Optional. Currently for single-select tiles only. Visual layout for the tile's items; 'carousel' lays the items out in a single row, centered on the selected item, with pill navigation above. The row has two sizes: in a modal at least 800px wide the selected card is enlarged and its neighbours peek in at a smaller size, and below that every card takes the smaller size and the selection is marked by its outline alone.

pill_nav_label.description: Optional. Currently for single-select tiles only, and only applies when 'layout' is 'carousel'. Accessible name for the carousel pill navigation.

data.description: Tile-specific data, determined by tile type. Most types take an array of items, one per rendered row, while a few (embedded_browser, theme-picker) take an object. Settings for the tile itself are siblings of this field.

source.description: pinnable_sites only. Where the tile draws its sites from. 'curated' (the default) uses the authored 'data' array. 'topFrecentSites' replaces it with the user's own most-used origins, computed locally from history. Currently only supported in Spotlight.

slots.description: pinnable_sites only. How many tiles the surface shows. Defaults to 5.

minPersonalized.description: pinnable_sites only, and only when source is 'topFrecentSites'. The fewest personalized origins the tile must produce for the message to be shown at all. When the user's history yields fewer, the message is withheld and records no impression. Defaults to 0, which permits an entirely backfilled, curated tile. A value above 'slots' always withholds the message, as does a tile left with no sites at all.

backfill.description: pinnable_sites only. When personalization yields fewer origins than 'slots', fill the remaining slots from the authored 'data' array rather than leaving them blank. Defaults to true.

TemplatedMessage.description: An FxMS message of one of a variety of types.

MultiMessage.description: An object containing an array of messages.
